translations.web: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
translations.bsb: In that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven above and the kings of the earth below.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will punish the host of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
